title: Training Notes — Storage Unit Rent on the Coming Month's Independent Living Statement
content:
Rented storage units are billed on the coming month's statement of an Independent Living Residency Agreement at the monthly storage rent per unit, which is 45.00 for every apartment type, from the Independent Living Studio to the Independent Living Cottage Home.

**Q. How is the number of units found?**
A. It is the quantity on the latest storage unit charge on the residency ledger (latest by service date).

**Q. What is added for each count?**

| Quantity on the latest storage unit charge | Added to the coming month's statement |
|---|---|
| Two or more | 45.00 once for each unit (for example 90.00 for two units) |
| One | 45.00 once |
| No storage unit charge on the ledger | Nothing for storage |

**Q. Is the rent prorated?**
A. No. Each rented unit adds a whole month's rent of 45.00.

**Q. Hypothetical case?**
A. A household whose latest storage unit charge carries a quantity of 3 adds 135.00 for storage to the coming month's statement.
